messages:
tanya_sales: Heads up 1 Vanguard Bank has asked for a short 2-week POC. Scope: SSO via SAML (Okta), SCIM for group -> role sync, RBAC enforcement, and domain proof for vanguardbank.com + vanguardbank.eu. They also want a quote for Hosted vs Dedicated for ~3M tokens/mo and ~5k users. Who can take this?
omar_se: I can run the technical POC. Quick ask: will they expose groups in the SAML assertion or prefer SCIM-only mapping?
chris_cust: We can include groups in the assertion but prefer SCIM for full sync. Okta is primary IdP.
omar_se: Great. High-level POC plan: 1) Set up test tenant on Hosted for speed 2) SAML test with Okta test metadata (ACS URL + entityID) 3) SCIM test with a sample 500-user import (use delta sync) 4) Configure RBAC mapping and test enforcement against a simple protected API call sample 5) Domain verification via TXT for both domains.
security_ops: For the questionnaire: we are SOC2 Type II and have documentation for KMS integrations. For POC, we can enable masked generation logs with audit export to S3 (90d). Production supports 13mo retention and customer-managed KMS. We also support VPC private deployments if they need no egress.
omar_se: SCIM specifics: hosted enforces 200 reqs/min per tenant. Recommend delta syncs and paging for large lists. Example mapping we ask: CSV with columns: scim_group,redwood_role.
chris_cust: Also need to confirm domain proof timelines and whether delegated DNS is acceptable. Their DNS team may not want to change TXT records.
security_ops: TXT proof preferred; verifies in ~5-10min after propagation but plan for up to 24h. We can offer delegated CNAME verification (we generate a CNAME you add) if they want minimal repeated changes. Delegated means we manage the verification pointer but not their zone.
infra_bot: new-preview-deploy created: preview/vanguardbank-poc-2024. Invite sent to chris@vanguardbank.com
omar_se: For SAML attributes we expect: email, given_name, family_name, groups (optional), and we support a custom claim tenant_id for automated tenant routing. If groups are not present, SCIM group membership will be primary.
tanya_sales: Pricing note: Hosted = usage-based; for 3M tokens/mo we can propose an enterprise slab with negotiated per-token. Dedicated = monthly commit + lower per-token usage. I'll draft estimates and share a short one-pager before the kickoff.
chris_cust: Can you also confirm auditability of each generation call (which user, which API, tokens consumed)? Compliance requires per-request metadata retained.
security_ops: Yes, we log request id, user id, model, prompt hash, token counts. For sensitive data we can support masking and log redaction. We'll include a sample audit export for review.
omar_se: Next steps: chris to drop Okta test metadata + a 10-user SCIM test token in shared drive; tanya will send proposed pricing; security_ops will share SOC2 + KMS docs. Proposed kickoff Thu 9am ET.
tanya_sales: Thu 9am ET booked. I'll attach the pre-call checklist (SAML metadata, SCIM token, DNS access or point-of-contact, role->group CSV). :calendar:
chris_cust: Thanks all, see you Thu.
